events.name: Bash
events.head: Run probe-details in static mode, show fails

events.name: Bash
events.head: Show tail of probe-details output
events.input: $ timeout 300 node app/scripts/probe-details.mjs - - 2>&1 | tail -20; echo EXIT $?

events.name: Bash
events.head: Run probe-details, capture output
events.input: $ node app/scripts/probe-details.mjs - - > /tmp/t240-pd.txt 2>&1; echo EXIT $?; wc -l /tmp/t240-pd.txt; grep -nE "FAIL|fill" /tmp/t240-pd.txt | head -20; tail -5 /tmp/t240-pd.txt

events.name: Bash
events.head: Show full output and fill check in probe
events.input: $ cat /tmp/t240-pd.txt | cut -c1-220; grep -n "fill\|screenshot" app/scripts/probe-details.mjs | head -30; git log --oneline -8 -- app/scripts/probe-details.mjs

events.name: Bash
events.head: Read probe usage and screenshot check
events.input: $ sed -n 1,40p app/scripts/probe-details.mjs | cut -c1-250; sed -n 265,345p app/scripts/probe-details.mjs | cut -c1-260
